Dear Partners,

The macro backdrop remains one of adjustment rather than crisis. Headline inflation has cooled to 3.8%, yet the policy rate sits at 5.25%, and high-yield spreads have widened to 640bps as credit markets continue to reprice risk more cautiously than the underlying fundamentals warrant. We read this as a market still working through a temporary dislocation in the cost of capital — a repricing, not a repudiation, of the private markets thesis. The recent gating of redemptions at Stonebeck Credit is a useful reminder of why we structured our fund with long-dated, drawdown capital rather than open-ended liquidity promises to our limited partners. Liquidity mismatches are a lender's problem before they are ever an operator's problem, and our portfolio companies do not answer capital calls with redemption gates.

Turning to performance: the flagship returned -2.0% for the quarter, bringing year-to-date performance to -3.5%, against a since-inception return of +18.0% that remains the truer measure of what this strategy is built to deliver over a full cycle.
